sections.text:
هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص الشهرى الخاص 
نظام 
الإطفاء التلقائي فى عنبر التربينات

حيث 
يوجد نظام كامل لمقاومة الحريق باستخدام 
 CO2
بعدد 32 اسطوانة موزعة على 
جزئين احدهما لكبائن التحكم والمساعدات والآخر للتربينة ذاتها كل جزء مكون من 16 
اسطوانة.

أعد المسودة 
الأولية المهندس / أحمد محمد المهتدى قمرة
 وإختبرها المهندس / 
هاني العقدة 
وراجعها

المهندس / السعيد 
شعبان عبد القادر 
ووافق عليها السيد 
المهندس / محمد الشريف مدير عام الأجهزة 
واعتمدها السيد 
المهندس / أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء النوبارية .

راجعها 
الكيميائي / 
إبراهيم يوسف يوسف مفتش السلامة والصحة المهنية بقطاع التفتيش 
ووافق على المستند 
المهندس / سمير عبد الجليل مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا 
لإنتاج الكهرباء ومنسق الشركة لنظام معلومات إجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد المهندس 
/ محمد نجيب 
عبد الحي 
رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء.

rows:
إصدار 
 أمر شغل معتمد من الجهة المختصة ويجب أن يحمل القائمون بأعمال الصيانة كارت 
 فئة السلامة والصحة المهنية .

تسوير 
 المكان لتحديد منطقة العمل وكذلك وضع علامات التحذير .

اتباع 
 إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية للأفراد والمعدات وإرتداء مهمات الوقاية 
 الشخصية ( خوذة أمان،حذاء 
 أمان، أفرول، جوانتى 
 .....)
شنطة العدة كاملة
سوائل تنظيف

تأكد من 
 استكمال عدد الاسطوانات بالنظام (32) اسطوانة

راجع 
 استجابة أوزان (أثقال) التعليق للحركة.

فحص 
 الأوزان الميكانيكية الموضوعة على الموزع لضمان استعداد استقرار النظام وعمله 
 عند الحاجة حيث أنه توجد أربع اسطوانات 
 common 
 إذا سقط الثقل الخاص بأي منها تم التهريب على بقية الاسطوانات.

تأكد 
 من سلامة التوصيلات الكهربية .
تأكد أن كل الأذرع معشقة مع بلوف الاسطوانات .

فحص 
 الإنذارات من لوحة التحكم المساعد ولوحة التحكم الرئيسي

فحص الـ 
 Pressure indicator 
 على خط الـ 
 Fire
تأكد من سلامة خطوط نظام الحريق

تأكد 
 من تجهيز كابينة الإطلاق حسب تعليمات التشغيل.

فحص ظاهرى لـ 
 Solenoid
 valve 
 والتأكد انه نظيف ويعمل

فحص ظاهرى لفوانى انطلاق غاز 
 CO2

sections_en.text: This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the automatic fire-fighting system in the turbine hall.

There is a complete fire-fighting system using CO2 with 32 cylinders distributed in two parts, one for the control cabinets and auxiliaries and the other for the turbine itself; each part consists of 16 cylinders.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Hani El-Oqda, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed El-Sherif, General Manager of Instruments, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves .....)
Complete tool bag
Cleaning fluids
Make sure the number of cylinders in the system is complete (32) cylinders
Check the response of the suspension weights (counterweights) to movement.

Inspect the mechanical weights placed on the distributor to ensure the system is ready and stable and operates when needed, since there are four common cylinders: if the weight of any one of them drops, discharge to the remaining cylinders takes place.
Make sure the electrical connections are sound.
Make sure all the levers are engaged with the cylinder valves.
Inspect the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.

Inspect the 
 Pressure indicator 
 on the 
 Fire line.
Make sure the fire system lines are sound.
Make sure the release cabinet is prepared according to the operating instructions.

Visual inspection of the 
 Solenoid
 valve 
, making sure it is clean and working.
Visual inspection of the CO2 gas discharge nozzles.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the automatic fire-fighting system in the turbine hall.
There is a complete fire-fighting system using CO2 with 32 cylinders distributed in two parts, one for the control cabinets and auxiliaries and the other for the turbine itself; each part consists of 16 cylinders.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Hani El-Oqda, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed El-Sherif, General Manager of Instruments, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card. | 
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves .....) | 
Tools, Equipment
and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag | 
Cleaning fluids | 
Procedures 
to be Carried Out
Make sure the number of cylinders in the system is complete (32) cylinders | 
Check the response of the suspension weights (counterweights) to movement. | 2.
Inspect the mechanical weights placed on the distributor to ensure the system is ready and stable and operates when needed, since there are four common cylinders: if the weight of any one of them drops, discharge to the remaining cylinders takes place. | 3.
Make sure the electrical connections are sound. | 4.
Make sure all the levers are engaged with the cylinder valves. | 5.
Inspect the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel. | 6.
Inspect the 
 Pressure indicator 
 on the 
 Fire line. | 7.
Make sure the fire system lines are sound. | 8.
Make sure the release cabinet is prepared according to the operating instructions. | 9.
Visual inspection of the 
 Solenoid
 valve 
, making sure it is clean and working. | 10.
Visual inspection of the CO2 gas discharge nozzles. | 11.
